headline: House Seeks Nvidia, Commerce Briefings on Megaspeed
deck: A U.S. committee asked company and Commerce officials to address export-control compliance and security controls by Dec. 2.
body: House Energy and Commerce Committee Chairman Brett Guthrie requested briefings from Nvidia interim chief executive Colette Kress, Commerce Secretary Lutnick and Under Secretary Kessler after recent reporting on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with alleged Chinese intelligence asset and Megaspeed executive Alice Huang [E1]. Guthrie said the reported events raised questions about Nvidia’s compliance with federal law on exporting advanced technologies and about its security controls [E2]. The letters seek briefings from Nvidia and Commerce by Dec. 2 [E3].

This new congressional request follows the paper’s 18 November report that Nvidia’s board does not intend to reinstate Huang as chief executive [E1][E9]. Cantor Fitzgerald said it holds no material proprietary positions in Nvidia, that most of its Nvidia holdings stem from client equity swaps, and that an implication was false and had no basis [E4][E5][E6].

Commerce initiated a 2024 investigation into Megaspeed over potential export-control violations after identifying suspicious activity, and Justice took the lead role in its criminal investigation following an enforcement action [E7][E8].
